Was there any thought behind your choice, or did you just pick Chimchar because it's cute?
Was there any thought behind your choice, or did you just pick Piplup because it's cute?
Was there any thought behind your choice, or did you just pick Turtwig because it's cute?
Let me enlighten you. Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can't extinguish the fire.
Let me enlighten you. Piplup is a poor walker but a skilled swimmer. Its thick down protects it from cold.
Let me enlighten you. Turtwig's shell is made of soil, and it can use its whole body to photosynthesize.
Anyhow, Chimchar is just the start. Investigate it and any other Sinnoh Pokémon you find, then report to Arlo when you're done.
Anyhow, Piplup is just the start. Investigate it and any other Sinnoh Pokémon you find, then report to Arlo when you're done.
If I had to choose, I'd pick Turtwig, too. I like Pokémon who are self-sufficient.
Anyhow, Turtwig is just the start. Investigate it and any other Sinnoh Pokémon you find, then report to Arlo when you're done.
Although it is unwilling, I need your help. I need more data on Dialga.
Although it is unwilling, I need your help. I need more data on Palkia.
On its own, it is already powerful enough to be considered a deity. But the Adamant Crystal unlocks the colossal power of its Origin Forme!
On its own, it is already powerful enough to be considered a deity. But the Lustrous Globe unlocks the colossal power of its Origin Forme!
Because of its incredible strength, Hisuian researchers believed Dialga's Origin Forme is actually its true form.
Hisuian researchers believed Origin Forme Palkia was actually imitating the creator of all things to gain its powers.
Imagine what I could accomplish with Dialga by my side. I must know more.
Imagine what I could accomplish with Palkia by my side. I must know more.
Took you long enough. We need the power of Origin Forme Dialga, NOW!
Took you long enough. We need the power of Origin Forme Palkia, NOW!
We're so close to finding the boss. And that professor of yours, too, I guess.
We're so close to finding the boss. And that professor of yours, too, I guess.
Tell Dialga to use Roar of Time, and get them home.
Tell Palkia to use Spacial Rend, and get them home.
I'm finally back. The moment I found Giovanni, I was swallowed up into a mysterious space. Truly, thank you both for helping me return home.
I am deeply relieved that you are safe. I advise you to get some rest, Professor Willow.
Unfortunately, I cannot rest yet. We still have one more thing to worry about, %PLAYERNAME%. Giovanni has also returned and he wants to take Origin Palkia and Origin Dialga from you.
Purify the Shadow Pokémon Team GO Rocket gave you, and defeat him before he can commit some further villainy.
Giovanni is still missing and your professor seems to be as well, how about we make a truce here and search for them both together? Not a bad suggestion, right?
Good. Then first, take one of these Pokémon off of my hands.
Do you recognize them? They're Turtwig, Chimchar, and Piplup, the first partner Pokémon chosen by trainers from the Sinnoh region.
Of course, we gave them a little "enhancement" of our own.
They have potential... But I'm no babysitter. That's your job.
Don't look so surprised, %PLAYERNAME%. We're here to help while our interests align and not a second longer.
Don't look so surprised, %PLAYERNAME%. We're here to help while our interests align and not a second longer.
After all, desperate times call for desperate measures. And speaking of time...
After all, desperate times call for desperate measures. And speaking of time...
Surely even YOU have noticed something's amiss.
Surely even YOU have noticed something's amiss.
These Pokémon don't belong in the present. But wherever they came from, that's where our Giovanni went.
These Pokémon don't belong in the present. But wherever they came from, that's where our Giovanni went.
So get looking. If you're lucky, you'll find your precious Willow too.
So get looking. If you're lucky, you'll find your precious Willow too.
I see...you are going to cooperate temporarily with TGR. It would certainly be better to cooperate now that we are in this situation, though we still need to be cautious.
After reading Willow's memo, it seems like there are some pretty strange things occurring right now.
Hisui is the old name for the Sinnoh region of the distant past.
The Hisui Region has a rich and unique natural environment, and the Pokémon ecosystem seems to be different. That's what Willow told me before.
Only the Space-Time Anomalies could cause them to appear in such numbers.
If you explore the areas where you find Hisuian Pokémon, we are certain to learn more about this strange phenomenon.
You there! I have work for you.
You there! I have work for you.
I'm close to uncovering the secrets of the Adamant Crystal. Catch Origin Dialga for me, and total control over time is ours.
I'm close to uncovering the secrets of the Lustrous Globe. Catch Origin Palkia for me, and total control over space is ours.
Of course I could catch Dialga myself. But I'm not going to waste my energy on errands when there's real work to do.
Of course I could catch Palkia myself. But I'm not going to waste my energy on errands when there's real work to do.
So this is Dialga? How fascinating. I wonder if it began the flow of time in my world, as well as yours.
So this is Palkia? How fascinating. I wonder if it stabilized space in my world, as well as yours.
During our research, Professor Willow told me the Adamant Crystal can transform Dialga into its Origin Forme.
During our research, Professor Willow told me the Lustrous Globe can transform Palkia into its Origin Forme.
Not only does Origin Forme Dialga resemble the creator Pokémon of Sinnoh's ancient myths, but also it can use Roar of Time to warp time itself.
Not only does Origin Forme Palkia resemble the creator Pokémon of Sinnoh's ancient myths, but also it can use Spacial Rend to warp space itself.
I am eager to see a demonstration.
I am eager to see a demonstration.
Hey, %PLAYERNAME%. Why didn't that move bring back the boss? There must be something missing..
Plenty of strong Pokémon were first found in Sinnoh, including a whole bunch of Pokémon evolutions we hadn't discovered before.
I'm planning on evolving some Pokémon myself. Who knows what they could evolve into!
HA! Don't think I'm telling you this outta the kindness of my heart.
The boss is everything to me. I'm real worried he's in trouble.
So quit dawdling! When the time comes, you better be strong enough to help.
Just when I thought I understood your world, it revealed a past that is just as strange and full of mystery.
Just when I thought I understood your world, it revealed a past that is just as strange and full of mystery.
Though we have not yet found Professor Willow or Giovanni, I am certain we are on the right path.
Though we have not yet found Professor Willow or Giovanni, I am certain we are on the right path.
While I continue to research, perhaps training with the Team GO Rocket Leaders could be useful.
While I continue to research, perhaps training with the Team GO Rocket Leaders could be useful.
With both Team GO Rocket and Dialga to help us, we will surely find Professor Willow soon.
With both Team GO Rocket and Palkia to help us, we will surely find Professor Willow soon.
I was just thumbing through my trusty field journal and thinking about how grateful I am for all the adventures you and I have shared.
We’ve researched wondrous Pokémon from regions near and far, triumphed over the troublesome Team GO Rocket, and forged some excellent friendships along the way.
And wouldn’t you know it, a new and exciting adventure is waiting just around the corner.
You see, a lush field of flowers has sprouted almost out of nowhere, and I suspect the cause just might be a Shaymin hiding nearby!
Spark says he got eyes on it and that this one might even be unique!
We can start an investigation by learning more about Pokémon first discovered in Kanto, Johto, Hoenn, and Sinnoh. After all, you know what they say: knowledge is power!
While you busied yourself gathering intel, I was studying up on Land Forme Shaymin.
In its Land Form, this Mythical Pokémon is said to disguise itself as a flowering plant to avoid detection.
A fact which leads me to conclude that some of these blossoms nearby could actually be our Shaymin, hiding in plain sight!
Since Land Forme Shaymin is a Grass type, let’s gather some Grass-type Pokémon for observation and research. Comparing their behaviors might provide valuable insights.
Good to see you again—oh, you’re wondering about these grass stains?
Erm... Well, I remembered a little factoid: the flowers on Shaymin’s body will burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and can sense gratitude.
Which is why I figured I’d try my luck hugging some flower patches. Makes total sense, right? Sadly, I didn’t find Shaymin. But as they say, you can only learn through trial and error!
Anyway, I promised to share more Shaymin facts, didn’t I? Here’s a nugget of knowledge for you!
Upon taking in the scent of a particular rare flower, Shaymin is enveloped in light—its tiny body changes into its Sky Forme, giving it the power of flight! Wouldn’t that be a sight to see?
And on that note, let’s study some Flying-type Pokémon for inspiration.
These findings will prove essential in pinpointing Shaymin’s exact location. Finding a Mythical Pokémon is never easy, but we’re so close.
Another fact! Did you know Shaymin is able to transform ruined lands by dissolving toxins in the air? Amazing!
Now then, you’ll want to be ready to catch Shaymin when it finally does appear, so now’s the time to train up!
How are your Poké Ball throwing skills? Let’s find out by putting them to the test!
Welcome back, %PLAYERNAME%! You look like you’d enjoy a fascinating Shaymin fact. Did you know it’s referred to as the Gratitude Pokémon?
And if we practice some acts of gratitude ourselves, we might just coax our floral friend out of hiding. It’s a win-win!
I’ve always found giving back to my friends deeply rewarding. And I’ll bet your friends would appreciate some Gifts too!
You’re also welcome to surprise your favorite professor with a few Pinap Berries any time, although that likely won’t help us find Shaymin...
Ahem. Now, remember to keep that heart filled with gratitude, and let’s continue our search!
Hello, %PLAYERNAME%! You are absolutely radiating gratitude!
Call it professor’s intuition, but I have a feeling all of our hard work is about to be rewarded.
Tracking down Mythical Pokémon is one of the toughest challenges a Trainer can undertake, but there’s nothing we can’t do when we work together!
Let’s keep our eyes on the prize: more learning, and more acts of kindness!
Masterful work! Phenomenal! Fantastic! I expected no less from you, %PLAYERNAME%!
You took on this great challenge, and your effort has paid off with a friend for life!
Now that I get a closer look at your new pal, I finally understand those sighting reports. You’ve caught yourself a Shiny Shaymin!
I can tell thanks to its unique color—always a telltale sign.
There’s no doubt that Shaymin can sense my sincere gratitude for all the hard work you’ve done to learn more about this fascinating Pokémon.
I look forward to whatever adventure awaits us next—and I’m already grateful for it!
Team GO Rocket has used the Adamant Crystal and Lustrous Globe to awaken the powers of Dialga and Palkia.
What's more, Professor Willow was investigating Giovanni's whereabouts when a rift in space-time occurred... I have not heard from him since.
Is the rift the result of Team GO Rocket unleashing the power of Palkia and Dialga by force?
Together, I am confident we can locate Professor Willow. Wherever -- or whenever -- he is.
A brilliant choice. If only we could travel like Dialga through time...
A wise choice. Studying Palkia's power over space may shine a new light on this mystery.
Look out for Team GO Rocket, %PLAYERNAME%.
Look out for Team GO Rocket, %PLAYERNAME%.
We may need their help to understand all of this and find Professor Willow.
We may need their help to understand all of this and find Professor Willow.
I will contact you again once my reconnaissance is complete.
I will contact you again once my reconnaissance is complete.
Did your investigation go well, %PLAYERNAME%? Mine also yielded new information.
Giovanni is missing as well. Judging by the agitation of his followers, his disappearance does not seem intentional.
We have to stop this. Professor Willow may be able to help us with some of the documents that he left behind.
Where would you rather focus your attention?
On Dialga, the Temporal Pokémon? Or on Palkia, the Spatial Pokémon?

Just what I thought. You have nothing to offer.
Do you have the skill to justify your foolish pride?
Tch... At least now I can study the source of your strength.
I should never have counted on a weakling like you.
Don't forget this is all for Team GO Rocket!
You better use that strength to help the boss!
See, I am the one who deserves this strong power.
We knew you would bring us back. I'm glad it all went according to plan. Now give me Origin Palkia and Origin Dialga.
I have traveled across time and space... Yet still, you are more powerful!
How disappointing. Train harder, and one day you might be of use to us.
A pity this alliance is temporary... You'd reach such heights if you joined Team GO Rocket.

%PLAYERNAME%! You won’t believe what just happened!
While you were teaching those Team GO Rocket Grunts a lesson, I took a cautionary stroll around the lab.
When I returned, I found the Adamant Crystal and Lustrous Globe had been stolen!
This must be why Team GO Rocket has been so active lately. Those thieving ruffians!
I’ll stay here and look for clues that might lead to where they’ve taken these items.
Meanwhile, can you and Rhi track down some more Grunts and see if you can get to the bottom of this?
I admire your success in defeating several Team GO Rocket Grunts, %PLAYERNAME%.
Unfortunately, they had little information about Team GO Rocket’s plans for the Adamant Crystal and Lustrous Globe.
Perhaps it would be wise to locate the Team GO Rocket Leaders.
I surmise they will know more about their organization’s plans.
Well done defeating the Team GO Rocket Leaders, %PLAYERNAME%.
Your determination never ceases to impress me, and your efforts were not in vain.
Each of the leaders’ hideouts contained information regarding Team GO Rocket’s scheme.
But we do not yet have the full picture.
As I suspected, it seems we must face Giovanni himself to find out what is really happening.
This will be a tough battle, %PLAYERNAME%, but I believe your courage and fortitude will lead you to victory.
Amazing! Unfortunately, we couldn’t find the Adamant Crystal or the Lustrous Globe in his hideout, but thanks to you we found oodles of other clues!
Hopefully, now we have all the pieces to better understand their nefarious plot.
I’ll gather the evidence and see what conclusions we can draw.
In the meantime, I noticed a few Team GO Rocket Grunts still lurking about. Would you scare them off?
Professor Willow just left the lab in a hurry.
He was greatly disturbed by what he uncovered in our investigation into Team GO Rocket and their plans with the Adamant Crystal and Lustrous Globe.
Did you know that Dialga can control time and Palkia can distort space?
With the stolen items, Team GO Rocket may attempt to harness Dialga and Palkia’s power to bend time and space for their own ends!
For now, let us wait for the professor’s return so we can learn how we can prevent this.
Thank you for your assistance. I am sure I will see you again soon.
I’m so glad to see you, %PLAYERNAME%!
I’m sure you’ve noticed more Team GO Rocket skulking about lately.
Would you mind poking around for clues about whatever scheme they’re up to now?
